instruction: Create a basic systemd service unit that runs a script
output:
<think>
The task requires us to create a basic systemd service unit that runs a script.
Best tool here is tee — tee operations.
Running with sudo — double-check the command before hitting enter, a typo here could cause trouble.
</think>
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=My Custom App
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/myapp
Restart=on-failure
User=myapp

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
